decisions.reason: 岭北行省右丞 is the Branch Secretariat right vice councilor (右丞), not a censorate office; 'censor-in-chief' invents 御史.
Same office error in the literal field: 右丞 is vice councilor, not censor-in-chief.
宣宁郡王 reads Xuanning, not Xuanding; the proposed place-name correction matches the Chinese.
三十万石 is three hundred thousand piculs; thirty thousand under-translates 万, and the next unit's cut to 十万 only makes sense from 三十万.
平章政事 is Manager of Governmental Affairs; Pacification Commissioner would be a different title (e.g. 宣抚).
Literal likewise misrenders 平章政事 as Pacification Commissioner; Manager of Governmental Affairs is correct.
中书平章政事 is Manager of Governmental Affairs of the Secretariat, not pacification commissioner.

浙西 is Zhexi (western Zhejiang); Jiangxi would be 江西.
Literal likewise misreads 浙西 as Jiangxi; Zhexi is required.
In appointment formulas 除…为… means to appoint X as Y, not to remove from office.
